_about: The Build Pack's flow programme, for the Programme page. Status comes from Evoflows: an Evoflows flow belongs to a programme flow through its 'programme' id in klaviyo/evoflows.py (FLOW_META). 'replaces' lists the live Klaviyo flows to switch off when it goes on. Edit this file (then redeploy) to update to-dos, answers or what each flow replaces.

flows.name: Welcome (non-customers)
flows.note: On Evoflows: the welcome text and the browser-specific Email 2 are dropped until Evoflows has SMS and product views.

flows.name: Membership journeys + 2b upgrade catch
flows.note: Both journeys (Free, Annual) are on Evoflows, switched off. They start on the portal's membership_changed event, which Luke hasn't scheduled yet.

flows.name: Cart abandonment
flows.gate: The cookie pop-up was fixed on 9 Oct and Evoflows' cart tracker went live on 12 Oct: ready to write once F3 is live.

flows.name: Back in stock
flows.gate: Needs a back-in-stock trigger on Evoflows: a 'notify me' button on product pages plus a stock check (requirements item 10).

flows.name: Price drop
flows.not_building: Gated: only if tracking is fixed and the catalogue sync and Price Drop trigger are confirmed (Q14).

flows.name: Order confirmation (transactional)
flows.not_building: Kept as it is; one QA pass only.

flows.name: Replenishment (consumables)
flows.not_building: Gated: only if the balls volume check passes (Q13).

flows.name: Winback
flows.gate: Needs open and click tracking and a daily-check trigger on Evoflows (requirements items 11, 13, 14).

flows.name: Sunset (re-permission, then suppress)
flows.gate: Needs open and click tracking, a daily-check trigger and a decision on what 'suppress' does (items 11, 14, 15).
